listeningQuestions.audio: The crew had to abandon the ship before the ice crushed it.
opts: 船员不得不在冰压碎船之前弃船。

listeningQuestions.audio: Shackleton crossed the mountains to find help at the whaling station.
opts: 沙克尔顿翻越群山去捕鲸站求助。
沙克尔顿留在海滩上等待。

listeningQuestions.audio: Courage is not the absence of fear but acting well in spite of it.
opts: 勇气不是没有恐惧,而是不顾恐惧仍做好事。

listeningQuestions.audio: When a problem feels too big, break it into small steps.
opts: 问题太大就等明年再说。
当问题显得太大时,把它拆成小步骤。

listeningQuestions.audio: I have been training every day to build up my endurance.
opts: 我每天训练来增强耐力。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you are going through a hard time, remember you are not alone.
opts: 艰难时你应该独自承受。
如果你正经历艰难,请记住你并不孤单。
艰难的日子永远不会结束。

quizQuestions.q: He showed great _____ by refusing to give up in the freezing Antarctic.
The captain gave the order to _____ ship before it sank.
They sailed for days on _____ seas before they reached the island.
Their _____ concern for others kept the whole group together.
I _____ for this climb for months, and I finally feel ready.
You look exhausted—_____ you been working out in the cold?
It _____ all morning, so the whole camp is wet through.
Quiet, please—the navigator _____ the map at this very moment.
Listen and choose the correct meaning.
opts: 他们靠燃烧动物脂肪来生火。
他们在岛上找到了许多树木。
quizQuestions.audio: They burned animal fat to make fire on the island.

quizQuestions.q: Listen and choose the correct meaning.
opts: 我们攀登的最大的山,往往在自己心里。
quizQuestions.audio: The biggest mountains we climb are often the ones inside our minds.

reading.passage: When the ship Endurance was crushed by ice, Shackleton and his crew were trapped in the Antarctic for months. By staying calm, taking one step at a time, and helping one another, every single man finally came home alive.
reading.passageCn: 当'坚忍号'被冰压碎时,沙克尔顿和他的船员被困在南极好几个月。靠着保持冷静、一步一步来、互相帮助,最终每一个人都活着回了家。

questions.q: What happened to the ship Endurance?
How did all the men finally survive?
opts: By staying calm and helping one another.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences to encourage a friend who is going through a hard time. Mention one way to overcome adversity.
writing.promptCn: 写几句话鼓励一位正经历困难的朋友,并提到一种克服逆境的方法。

lines.text: We must choose two more sailors for the rescue boat.
lines.cn: 我们得为救援船再挑两名水手。

lines.text: I think we need Worsley. He is an excellent navigator.
lines.cn: 我觉得需要沃斯利,他是出色的领航员。

lines.text: And Crean, for his strength to row for days.
lines.cn: 还有克林,要靠他的力气连日划船。

lines.text: Agreed. Let's tell the captain and set off soon.
lines.cn: 同意。我们去告诉船长,尽快出发。

lines.text: The expedition leaves next month. Have you been preparing?
lines.cn: 远征下个月出发,你一直在准备吗?

lines.text: Yes, I've been training every day to build up my endurance.
lines.cn: 是的,我每天训练来增强耐力。

lines.text: Good. The cold and long marches will test us all.
lines.cn: 很好。严寒和长途行军会考验我们所有人。

lines.text: With good preparation and courage, we'll be fine.
lines.cn: 有充分准备和勇气,我们会没事的。
